_note: Who may read a case's grants list (dossiq change case-access-card-lists-team-and-group-grants, design D-4): the case's assignee and the background service. OpenRegister answers GET /api/objects/dossiq/case/{id}/grants only for a caller its readGrants rule admits, beside the owner, the owning group, administrators, manage holders and grant_manage holders (openregister change an-object-lists-its-grants-with-their-origin). readGrants never resolves default-open, so without this rule an assignee reads the Toegang card's refusal text. The match is the one the case's read and update rules carry, so the people who see a case's links see its grants too. CaseTeamAccessProjector starts from the merged fragments and only appends the handling team entries to read and update, so this key survives a recompute. authorization is a key the schema importer compares, so the case version stays.
